# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Application Window

- **Title Bar**: Displays "TaxReturn.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc" indicating the active document and application.
- **System Tray**: Located at the top-right corner, includes minimize, maximize, and close buttons.
- **Date and Time**: Displayed as "Oct 23 16:38" in the top-center of the window.
- **Application Menu Bar**: Contains standard menu items: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help.
- **Desktop Environment**: The application is running within a Linux desktop environment, as indicated by the "Activities" button on the top-left and the application dock on the left side.

## Application Dock (Left Sidebar)

- **Application Icons**: A vertical dock on the left side contains icons for various applications:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc (currently active)
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (Question Mark)
  - Trash

## Toolbar

- **Formatting Toolbar**: Located directly below the menu bar, includes:
  - Font selection dropdown (currently set to "Calibri")
  - Font size dropdown (currently set to "11 pt")
  - Bold (B), Italic (I), Underline (U) buttons
  - Text color and background color selectors
  - Alignment buttons (left, center, right, justify)
  - Number formatting buttons (e.g., decimal places, percentage, currency)
  - Borders and fill color options
  - Font effects (e.g., strikethrough, superscript, subscript)
  - Special characters (Ω) and symbols
  - Link and comment tools
  - Grid and table formatting tools
  - Drawing tools (pen, shapes, etc.)
  - Formula bar with cell reference (B4) and formula input field (currently showing "1200000")

## Status Bar

- **Sheet Navigation**: Displays "Sheet 1 of 1" indicating the current sheet.
- **Sheet Name**: "TaxReturn" is highlighted, indicating the active sheet.
- **Page Style**: "PageStyle_TaxReturn" is displayed, indicating the current page style.
- **Language**: "English (Hong Kong)" is shown, indicating the current language setting.
- **Statistics**: "Average: $1,200,000; Sum: $1,200,000" is displayed, indicating summary statistics for selected cells.
- **Zoom Level**: "100%" is shown, indicating the current zoom level.
- **Navigation Controls**: Includes buttons for navigating between sheets and zooming in/out.

## Document Content

- **Document Title**: "Corporate Tax Return - 2024" is centered at the top of the spreadsheet.
- **Revenues Section**:
  - **Product Sales**: $1,200,000 (cell B4)
  - **Service Revenue**: $450,000 (cell B5)
  - **Investment Income**: $50,000 (cell B6)
  - **Other Income**: $15,000 (cell B7)
  - **Total Revenue**: $1,715,000 (cell B8)
- **Expenses Section**:
  - **COGS**: $600,000 (cell B11)
  - **Salaries**: $400,000 (cell B12)
  - **Rent**: $120,000 (cell B13)
  - **Marketing**: $80,000 (cell B14)
  - **R&D**: $150,000 (cell B15)
  - **Depreciation**: $50,000 (cell B16)
  - **Travel**: $20,000 (cell B17)
  - **Utilities**: $30,000 (cell B18)
  - **Other Expenses**: $15,000 (cell B19)
  - **Total Expenses**: $1,465,000 (cell B20)
- **Tax Calculation Section**:
  - **Taxable Income**: $250,000 (cell B22)
  - **Tax Rate**: 21.00% (cell B23)
  - **Tax Liability**: $52,500 (cell B24)

## Sidebar Panels

- **Right Sidebar**: Contains several panels:
  - **Function Panel**: Includes a function button (fx) for inserting functions.
